scripts.lint:ts: tsc --noEmit && eslint --cache --report-unused-disable-directives-severity 0 --ignore-pattern 'test/tests/*.js' --ignore-pattern 'test/vue/src/*.ts' . && eslint --no-ignore --no-inline-config --no-config-lookup -c eslint.build.mjs build/eslint.js build/eslint-plugin-vue.js
scripts.lint:bundle: eslint --no-ignore --no-config-lookup --report-unused-disable-directives-severity 0 --no-inline-config --rule 'no-unused-vars: [2, {args: "none", caughtErrors: "none", ignoreRestSiblings: true}]' build/eslint.js build/eslint-plugin-vue.js
scripts.lint: npm run lint:ts && npm run lint:md
scripts.build: npm run bundle && npm run minify && tsc && npm run build:test
scripts.coverage: npx testUtil --require=./test/runner.js --test-coverage-include='**/eslint{,-plugin-vue}.js' test/tests/*.js test/vue/dist/*.test.js test/*.test.js && node test/coverage.js
scripts.clean: find test/tests/ -type f -name '*.js' | xargs gsed -i 's|"../../../lib/rule-tester/rule-tester"|"../rule-tester"| ; s|rule = require(.*)|rule = __filename| ; s|"../../_utils"|"../utils"| ; s|rule-to-test/||g'; eslint --fix --report-unused-disable-directives-severity 0 test/tests/*.js
scripts.clean:vue: find test/vue/src/ -type f -name '*.ts' | xargs gsed -i "s|../../eslint-compat|../../rule-tester.js| ; s|import rule from .*|const rule = 'eslint-plugin-vue'| ; s|../../test-utils/typescript|../../typescript.js| ; s|import { eslintStylisticVersion } from .*|const eslintStylisticVersion = undefined| ; s|parser: require.resolve('@typescript-eslint/parser'),\{0,1\}||g ; s|__dirname, '../../|process.cwd(), './|"; eslint --fix --no-inline-config test/vue/src/*.ts
